title: Conflicts Of The Bahmani Successor States With Vijayanagar
definition: The geopolitical struggle between the five Bahmani successor states (Deccan Sultanates) and the Vijayanagara Empire, primarily driven by control over the Raichur Doab, the Krishna-Godavari delta, and the Marathwada region.
importanceInUpsc: This topic is central to understanding the shifting power dynamics of Medieval India, the evolution of military technology (artillery), and the eventual decline of the Vijayanagara Empire post-1565.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Conflicts Of The Bahmani Successor States With Vijayanagar.
